summary: Implemented the Tabs widget in src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py and exported it from textual.widgets. It supports click-to-nearest-tab, left/right wrapping, 1-based number keys, and letter cycling. With no tabs it renders only the inactive underline. I added a demo at sandbox/tabs.py. Nothing was run or tested, nothing was committed, and no unit tests were added. Tabs are fixed at construction time, and no message is posted on tab change.
